name: Barbell Curl
instructions: A fundamental bicep builder that targets the Biceps and Forearms through elbow flexion. The barbell allows for maximal loading and overall strength development. Essential for developing arm size and pulling strength. 1. Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding the barbell with a secure grip. 2. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and palms facing forward (underhand grip). 3. Contract your biceps to curl the weight up, keeping your upper arms stationary. 4. Squeeze your biceps hard at the peak of the movement. 5. Lower the weight slowly, resisting gravity until your arms are fully extended. 6. Maintain constant tension on the muscle and avoid using momentum.
